q: What do we use to watch the system in production — the ops console?

results.text: The production deploy window is Friday afternoons.
The gateway must never log full request bodies in production; pino structured logging with redacted fields is the convention.
Authorization is enforced by the policy engine; the identity module (renamed from auth) reads its configuration from identity.yaml.
Alerts route to the #aurora-oncall Slack channel.
The production deploy window is Tuesdays at 14:00 UTC since May.
Staging runs Postgres 16 after the October migration; the old Postgres 14 cluster is decommissioned.
The operations dashboard is Grafana, dashboard name aurora-ops.
The p99 latency budget for the gateway is 250 milliseconds.
Backups go to the nightly S3 bucket with 30-day retention.
The admin API is mounted under /_admin and requires the internal bearer token.
